snippet.title: Across the Timeways | Expansion Reveal | Hearthstone
snippet.description:
Across the Timeways brings 145 brand-new cards, introduces two all-new Keywords, Fabled and Rewind, and unites legendary heroes from the past, future, and alternate timelines.

Join Chromie of the Bronze Dragonflight in a race to stop Murozond from collapsing every timeline into the End Time. Recruit 11 iconic heroes, each with unique powers and allies from their own eras.

New Keywords:
Fabled - Legendary heroes arrive with two extra Legendary cards that slot straight into your deck.
Rewind - Replay cards with random effects for another shot at the perfect outcome.

Log in now to claim your FREE Legendary: Mister Clocksworth! Earn three more free cards through the in-game shop and the upcoming Across the Timeways event.

Get early access in the Pre-Release Tavern Brawl starting October 28, where you can open and play with your pre-purchased cards ahead of launch, and collect even more packs before time runs out.

Across the Timeways launches November 4, 2025. Follow our social channels for card reveals and updates as the countdown begins.

Pre-purchase Across the Timeways Mega Bundle: https://us.shop.battle.net/en-us/product/hearthstone-across-the-timeways-mega-bundle#optLogin=true
Learn more about Across the Timeways: https://news.blizzard.com/article/24226328
Read the full 33.6 Patch Notes: https://news.blizzard.com/article/24232759
Across the Timeways Card Library: https://hearthstone.blizzard.com/cards
